# Installing a cluster on {{ ibm_power_server_title }} in a disconnected environment {#installing-restricted-networks-ibm-power-vs}

To install a OpenShift Container Platform cluster on {{ ibm_power_server_name }} in a disconnected environment, mirror the required release content and deploy into an existing Virtual Private Cloud (VPC) on {{ ibm_cloud_name }}.
